reader.requirement: At --std 85 a sequential-file input-output statement that fails for a condition the implementor specifies (one the 1985 list 00-49 does not define, such as a LINAGE value that breaks VII.3.7.4 GR2/GR3) is unsuccessful and sets an implementor-defined 9x I-O status that duplicates no 00-49 condition, and the 1985 path sets no status value the 1985 list lacks (no 2002+ value such as 61 or 71); where more than one value applies the implementor chooses. Witnesses cover the LINAGE violation at OPEN OUTPUT (90, file not opened, then 48/42/41) and the exception condition.

reader.notes: The implementor-defined conditions take 90 (LINAGE values) and 91 (a character with no byte image), both 9x and distinct from 00-49, and the 85 path refuses the 2002+ facilities whose values (61, 71, 31 via ASSIGN USING, 45 via FORMAT) the 1985 list lacks. Observation outside this rule: at 85 OPEN OUTPUT of a second connector on a physical file another connector is writing succeeds and truncates it, then READ gives 10; 1985 states no sharing rule, so this is implementor latitude.

refuter.evidence: Attack: look for a status outside the 1985 sequential list, or a 9x that duplicates a 00-49 condition, on paths the reader did not try. rst1-003 (--std 85, USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR on all files): OPEN OUTPUT into a nonexistent directory -> 30 (not 35, which 1985 reserves for INPUT/I-O/EXTEND); WRITE after that failed OPEN -> 48; two connectors OPEN I-O on one file, READ both, REWRITE both -> 00 throughout (no 51 record lock, no 61); OPEN EXTEND and OPEN INPUT on a missing non-optional file -> 35; READ after the failed OPEN -> 47; CLOSE of a closed file -> 42; OPEN after CLOSE WITH LOCK -> 38. rst2 (ASSIGN TO WS-NAME, a data-name holding spaces) at --std 85 -> OPEN 00: the name is taken as an implementor-name, so the dynamic-ASSIGN 31 (FileConnector.cs#AssociationFailure) is not reachable at 85. Every value is in the 1985 list. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.1.3.5 (9x "must not duplicate any condition specified by the I-O status values 00 through 49"); OK §1985:VII.1.3.5 (35 "an OPEN statement with the INPUT, I-O, or EXTEND phrase is attempted").
